Hi Priya — great to hear Kala wants to move forward. I put together a tranche-based MAP draft and a short SOW stub to align checkpoints to commercial commitments. Key points in the attached MAP_v2 (high level):

1) Three checkpoints
  - Pilot (30 days): limited seats, no commit; 25k credit tranche upon pilot start to cover e2e eval tokens. Acceptance criterion: perf within 10% of demo latencies + integration smoke tests passing.
  - Acceptance (60 days after pilot): customer sign-off on eval prompt set; commit option for 3 months at a 10% discount if commit >= 500k tokens/month. 50k credit tranche released on acceptance.
  - Production ramp (90-day rollout): staged ramp to target QPS with automated KV caching enabled. Final tranche unlocks with commit to 12-month reserved capacity; ramp discount scale up to 20% based on committed QPS.

2) Pricing table (attached) — per-token list price, commitment breakpoints, and suggested incentives for early ramp.

3) Operational asks from Kala: smoke-test dataset, expected peak concurrency, and RD access window for integration.

Next steps: we can lock tranche amounts and exact discount tiers on a call Thursday 11/30. I copied Rishi and Marissa to confirm commercial/finance guardrails and Karthik for deployment SLAs.
